text: Cadillac is one of General Motors' vehicle brands: GM's FY2025 10-K says its vehicles are developed, manufactured and/or marketed under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet and GMC brands, and the security-ownership table in GM's 2026 proxy lists only BlackRock (8.3%) and State Street (5.2%) as the persons known to GM to beneficially own more than 5% of its common stock as of the dates in the table's footnotes.
short: Cadillac is a vehicle brand of General Motors (NYSE: GM).

source.name: General Motors Co, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: with vehicles developed, manufactured, and/or marketed under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC brands

additionalSources.name: General Motors Co, 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR) - security ownership table
